label: Inspect active resolver configuration
expected: Identify the DNS servers and interface used by the affected client.

label: Query the lab hostname against the configured resolver
expected: Distinguish a timely DNS response, NXDOMAIN, and a resolver timeout.

label: Check application access through the lab hostname
expected: Test hostname resolution and HTTP response together.

label: Inspect device-mapper paths
expected: Compare active paths with the documented four-path baseline.

label: Collect several I/O samples
expected: Observe latency and utilization across several samples.

label: Review recent kernel events
expected: Correlate link resets and path changes with the incident window.

label: Inspect the Data Guard configuration
expected: Read current broker status and warnings.

label: Read standby lag measurements
command: SELECT name, value, unit FROM v$dataguard_stats;
expected: Separate transport and apply lag on the standby.

label: Inspect time synchronization
expected: Check whether host timestamps can be correlated.
